# Xenovoya

Launch the Xenovoya open alpha: a cooperative on-chain hex expedition on Sepolia about exploring, sharing discoveries, and escaping together.

## Core Pages

- [Play Xenovoya](https://play.xenovoya.com): Launch the Xenovoya open alpha: a cooperative on-chain hex expedition on Sepolia about exploring, sharing discoveries, and escaping together.
- [Xenovoya data and privacy](https://play.xenovoya.com/privacy): Understand local storage, optional wallet-linked return history, privacy-safe analytics, export, deletion, and public on-chain records.
